translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Entsaba manda juipunutyujtyu jumu
Entsaba manda jumu anjee, ya' juipunu tyujtyu pakaanmalan, ma makara kai'sha chumuren tusha pajtya' tsuna katawayu, tsenñu juntsanu jelekenuu juwan juru jumu juukapa juukenu llavi dekuwa.
Tsenñu jelekenuu juwan juru juukapa juukenmalan, aa urnunu ñivijcha lun tsa-i' pureitu pajtanu dishkemin, naa ishuwanu bain juntsa tene tiyai' tsaa kepewaakiwa.
Tsenñu juntsa ñivijchanu dendu-ishu tene pure' faleke', tusha na'baasa deshaja' jideiwa. Tsenñu juntsa ishulanu, entsa tusha alagaa fi' naake kityawaamuñuba juntsanguenuu detirewa.
Tsejtu naa ti tape juulanu bain, naa chi juulanu bain mushki'mujchi, matyu llashkapanu Dioschi muute tsutajtu chachillanu tene firu' kikidei, tiwa juntsa dendu-ishulanu.
Tsejtu tsangue' bain tu'tyumujchi kityawaanchin ne kike' man chu'chaya tsanguentsudei ti' uuden dekiwa. Juntsa dendu-ishula alagaa fi' kityawaren tsanguemu jula.
Tsaanu malutala chachilla peyanu tyanu detsuve; tsaaren naa peyanu tya' bain, peyan dejutyuve, naa-i' peyan tsaanu tsuve.
Entsa dendu-ishula, vinguenu jinundiyandu kawallunu sekuwanguikeñu deewa; dendu-ishula' mishusha uru mishmunderu keraa puka deewa, tsenmin yala' kajuuya cha' kajuru kera deewa.
Supuu achuwa kera deewa, tsenmin tejkuya leun tejku kera deewa,
tsenmin yala' tenbapuya, vinguendu pana panakenu jeru jali keraachi dishu deewa, tsenmala jekenmala yala' ja'chiya, vinguendu jinu karu kawalluchi juyaa pure' jiindu waratin tsa tsa detiwa.
Tsenmala yala' nepeleya alagaa nepele kera deju' ityu pudeewa. Juntsachi chachillanu man chu'chaya' mitya taaju puiwaantsunu jula.

Tsenmala yaichi rei ju' uudenguemuya jelekenuu juwan jurunu washnamu anjeeya juwa, matyu hebreo palaachiya Abadón, griego palaachiya Apolión, tsandishu juntsaa “na'baasa defiru' ke' dekikemu” ti' mumu putu.
Ajke' taaju i' puiwara yumaa puive, tsaaren taaju i' puinu kayu pallu juve.
Entsaba mandishmainjuipunu tyujtyu jumu
Entsaba mandishmain jumu anjee, ya' juipunu tyujtyu pakaanmalan, Diosa' ajuusha uruchi jumu ufeenda tsure' keewaanunu taapai mutu kachu keraa usnanutala pañu meejawa.
Tsejtu juipuntsumi tyujtyu tanamu anjeenu tsandiwa: Éufrates aa pi keesha taapai anjee teetsudenashu juntsalanu delanbude, tiwa.

Tsenñu juntsa taapai anjeelanu delanbuwa, matyu juntsa uranu, juntsa malunu, juntsa chu'chayanu, tsenmin juntsa añunu, tsanguenu tirawa de' mitya, tu kuraa chumu chachillanu pen pela vele' keekiñunguiñuya, manbaate chachillanuya tu'nudetsu.
Tsenñu kawallunu chuu vinguenu jimula 200'000.000 juve detiñu meewayu.

Tsejtu iya kipin tsa-i' juntsa katandu, kawallunu bain, naa kawallunu chumulanu bain entsangue katawayu: vinguenu jindu tenbapunu dishkaantsumi jeru pana deewa. Juntsala ñillu keraa ungalala deewa, tsenmin lushkatataa jasintu keraa, naa lajkililii ju'kemu asufee keraa bain ma judeewa. Tsenmin kawai mishpukaya leun mishu kera deewa, tsenmin yala' fi'pakishaya ñi bain, ñivijcha bain, ju'kemu asufee bain fala falake jadya jadya dekiwa.
Tsenñu juntsa kawallu fi'pakisha ñi bain, ñivijcha bain, ju'kemu asufee bain fale falekemulachi, tu kuraa chumu chachilla pen pela vele' keekiñunguiñuya, manbaate chachillaya tsaa depeya deiwa.
Matyu kawallu yala' fi'pakichee firu' ikaakenuu dejuwa naa yala' nepelechi bain. Yala' nepeleya aa piñi keraa mishu pudeewa; juntsachee chachillanu firu' ke' ta'kemu deewa.

Entsa tsaa depuiñu peyatyu' laramu chachilla, ne tsaive tya' yala firu' kiikemu deju'ba veta' pensa demantyuwa; tsaju' naa dyabululanu bain, tsenmin naa katabanguityu, naa merebanguityu, naa neba ityu uru dyusnu bain, naa lushi kenu jeru dyusnu bain, naa brunse dyusnu bain, naa shupu' dyusnu bain, naa chi dyusnu bain, yalanaa teedi' aawa kure' keewaawaa kentsula.
Tsenmin naa cha' tu'mula bain, naa mirukula bain, naa vee matsaimula bain, naa taamula bain jayuuba yala naakentsumuwa deju'ba manbashi' veta' pensa mangui'la.
